title: Jamaican Cheese Crumble
description: A spicy twist on the classic crumble, featuring a Jamaican-inspired filling and a crunchy topping. Perfect for a snack or dessert.
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine the velvety, Jamaican, and cream. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the mixture thickens.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and stir in the cheese until melted and smooth.
Transfer the cheese mixture to a 9x9-inch baking dish.
In a small bowl, mix together the crumble and a pinch of salt.
Spread the crumble mixture evenly over the top of the cheese filling.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the crumble is golden brown and the filling is heated through.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
